short_description: Sentinel — a federal benefits agency's improper-payment prevention system. A spike of high-risk pre-disbursement payments (triggered by a cross-agency fraud-match feed + eligibility-data refresh ~3 weeks ago) surfaced duplicate identities, deceased payees, income mismatches, and cross-agency fraud flags. A payment-integrity app reads governed payment data at low latency, a disposition recommendation ranks the move (hold / release / investigate) per payment risk and projected recovery, and an examiner approves — turning governed lakehouse data into a fraud-prevention action, with the assistant's AI spend bounded and observable.
